channel.title: Trail Tater Campfire
channel.description: Trail Tater campground trips, family adventures, camp cooking, history, and stories from along the way.

item.title: Back to Lost River Valley Campground in 2027
item.description: Trail Tater is planning a return to Lost River Valley Campground in North Woodstock, New Hampshire, July 28 through August 3, 2027. The new update includes the working family-campout plan, preferred sites, camp cooking, Clark's Bears, and Billie and Kalley's presentation.
